title: The Last Post Ceremony commemorating the service of (5/673) Private Kenneth George Sketchley 3rd Battalion, the Royal Au
summary: The Last Post Ceremony is presented in the Commemorative area of the Australian War Memorial each day. The ceremony commemorates more than 102,000 Australians who have given their lives in war and other operations and whose names are recorded on the Roll of Honour.
